meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 工单评论变成聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们用 Linear 管理项目，想在聊天里跟进工单讨论
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Linear for project management and want to discuss issues in chat

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Chat SDK 接入 Linear 频道，自动参与工单评论线程。每当 Linear 工单有新评论，Claude 会自动回复，无需 @ 提及。
howto.when: 当 Linear 工单的评论线程有新评论时触发。需要先完成安装和配置（包括 OAuth 应用或 API 密钥、Webhook、环境变量）。

say.text: 帮我回复 Linear 工单 ENG-123 的最新评论。
say.note: Claude 会读取该工单的评论线程并生成回复。

say.text: 总结一下 Engineering 团队所有未关闭工单的讨论。
say.note: Claude 会遍历相关工单的评论线程并汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can integrate with Linear via Chat SDK, automatically participating in issue comment threads. Every comment on a Linear issue triggers the agent without needing @-mention.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment is added to a Linear issue thread. Requires prior setup including OAuth app or API key, webhook, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Reply to the latest comment on Linear issue ENG-123.
say_en.note: Claude reads the thread and generates a reply.

say_en.text: Summarize all open issue discussions for the Engineering team.
say_en.note: Claude traverses relevant issue threads and summarizes.
